blocks.text: The Philippine Navy spotted two warships of the People’s Liberation Army Navy (PLAN) and one ship of the China Coast Guard (CCG) near Bajo de Masinloc, also known as Scarborough Shoal, during maritime patrols in the West Philippine Sea on Thursday.
